notes: Assertions mostly non-discriminating: 16 of 17 passed in both configs. Only modular-tabs/01 (smoke test) separated them: baseline crashes lm() when Fit is clicked before server-filled column selects exist (missing req()). Low real-world reachability.

Quality differences favour with_skill in every case but are not captured by assertions: validate() messages instead of blank/empty outputs (explorer, upload), n counts non-missing values (upload), x==y guarded and bad bookmark dataset handled (modules), restored column choices via restoreInput (modules).
Cost: with_skill used ~2x wall time (+68s mean) and +39% tokens, mostly reading references and running check_app.R plus extra testServer scripts.

check_app.R had two false-positive bugs found during this iteration (plot brush ids, empty selects); both fixed mid-iteration and all six apps re-checked with the fixed script. Grades reflect the fixed checker.
Skill edits made after these runs (land in iteration-2): tested no-pandoc HTML report snippet in outputs.md; R/ folder helper-visibility rule; req() guard rule for server-filled inputs.
Next iteration should add harder, more discriminating assertions: graceful messages on empty/invalid input, n semantics with NA, behaviour after dataset switch, no hard-coded getwd() paths.
